app.name: evo-agents hub
app.description: The team's shared store for memories, skills, plans and knowledge graphs.

login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Sign in to evo-agents hub
login.description: Use your GitHub account. The hub reads only your GitHub login and never stores a GitHub token.
login.notConfigured: Web sign-in is not enabled on this hub. An administrator needs to set the client secret, the session secret and the hub's public URL.
login.unreachable: The hub API cannot be reached. Reload the page in a few minutes.
login.access: You only see the projects an administrator has granted to your account.
login.cli: On your machine, sign the CLI in with evo-agents hub login.

projectSwitcher.label: Projects
projectSwitcher.none: No project has been granted to you yet
projectSwitcher.loadError: The project list could not be loaded
projectSwitcher.hint: Open a project to see its content

userMenu.grants: {count, plural, =0 {No project grants yet} one {Granted on # project} other {Granted on # projects}}
userMenu.logoutFailed: Sign-out did not go through. Try again in a moment.

home.title: My projects
home.description: The projects the hub returns for your account, with your role and the highest label level you may see.
home.count: {count, plural, =0 {No projects} one {# project} other {# projects}}
home.emptyTitle: No project has been granted to you yet
home.emptyDescription: Ask a hub administrator to grant a role to {login}, then reload this page.

project.title: Project overview
project.noHarness: The project was registered without its harness paths.
project.adminWithoutGrant: You are a hub administrator without a role in this project: you can manage it but cannot read its content.

ladder.title: Label ladder
ladder.description: Levels from lowest to highest. You see content labelled up to your max level.

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: The repos declared in the project's harness.
repos.name: Repo

sinks.title: Sinks
sinks.description: Where the project's content may go, with the highest label level allowed there.

admin.title: Hub administration
admin.description: The number of rows in each hub table. Only hub administrators can see this page.

filters.invalidRange: The end date must be on or after the start date.
filters.invalidLogin: A login has only letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, and does not start with a hyphen.

pager.label: {what} pages
pager.rows: {count, plural, =0 {No rows} one {# row on this page} other {# rows on this page}}

errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Taking you to the sign-in page…
errors.forbidden: The hub refused: your account is no longer a hub admin, or your session changed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.conflict: The data changed before your action reached the hub. The list was reloaded.
errors.invalid: The hub did not accept this.
errors.server: The hub failed to save the change. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, send the request id to whoever runs the hub.
errors.network: Cannot reach the hub API. Check the connection and try again.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who signed in or were granted access ahead of time, with their role and highest label level in each project. Every grant and revocation is audited.
members.emptyDescription: People show up here after their first sign-in, or once you grant access to their GitHub login.
members.noMatchDescription: Try another login or pick all projects.

member.notFoundDescription: The hub has no such user. The login may be misspelled, or the person has neither signed in nor been granted access.
member.summary: On the hub since {created}. Last seen: {lastSeen}.
member.grantsDescription: The role and the highest label level this person can see in each project.
member.grantsEmptyDescription: {login} sees no project on the hub. Grant a role so they can read or write a project's content.
member.changeLabel: Change the access of {login} to project {project}
member.revokeLabel: Revoke the access of {login} to project {project}
member.tokensDescription: CLI machine tokens and web sessions of this person that still work.
member.activityDescription: The latest actions this person took on the hub.
member.allActivity: See all of it in the audit trail

grant.title: Grant project access
grant.description: Pick the user, the project, the role and the highest label level they may see. You confirm on the next step.
grant.loginHint: You can grant access to someone who has never signed in; it takes effect at their first sign-in.
grant.noProjects: The hub has no project yet. Register one with evo-agents hub project register, then come back here.

roleHints.reader: Reads the project's memories, plans, skills and knowledge graph, up to the highest level.
roleHints.writer: Reader, plus pushing memories, plans, skills and the knowledge graph to the hub.
roleHints.admin: Writer, plus registering the project again from its harness.

grant.maxLevelHint: The project's label ladder, lowest first. This person sees content labelled up to this level.
grant.existing: {login} is {role}, level {level} on this project. Saving replaces that with the new choice.
grant.unchanged: {login} already has exactly this role and level. Nothing to change.
grant.confirmDescription: Check before saving. The action is audited under your name.
grant.notFound: Project {project} is no longer on the hub. Close this dialog and pick another project.

revokeGrant.title: Revoke the access of {login} to project {project}?
revokeGrant.description: From their next request, {login} no longer sees project {project} or its content. Their access to other projects and their tokens stay as they are. The action is audited.
revokeGrant.notFound: This access was revoked already. The list was reloaded.
revokeGrant.success: Revoked the access of {login} to project {project}.

tokens.title: Tokens and sessions
tokens.description: CLI machine tokens and web sessions of every user. Revoking one makes the next request made with it get a 401, from any machine.
tokens.caption: Tokens and sessions
tokens.emptyDescription: Change the user, kind or state to see other tokens.

revokeToken.title: Revoke token {id} of {login}?
revokeToken.machine: Machine {host} gets a 401 on its next request and has to run evo-agents hub login again.
revokeToken.web: This web session is signed out on its next request.
revokeToken.current: This is the session you are using: revoking it signs you out at once.
revokeToken.audit: This cannot be undone, and it is audited.
revokeToken.notFound: The hub no longer has this token. The list was reloaded.
revokeToken.conflict: This token was revoked already. The list was reloaded.
revokeToken.success: Revoked token {id} of {login}. The next request made with it gets a 401.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Every action that changed something on the hub: who, with which token, what, on which target and in which project. The trail holds no content and no credential.
audit.caption: Audit trail, newest first
audit.timeZone: Days are counted in the {zone} time zone.
audit.emptyTitle: No audit row matches the filters
audit.emptyDescription: Loosen the filters, for example drop the actor or widen the dates.

states.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
states.forbiddenDescription: The hub API refused the request for your account. If you need access, ask a hub administrator for a suitable role.
states.notFoundDescription: This page does not exist, or it belongs to a project you cannot see.
states.projectNotFoundDescription: The project is not registered on the hub, or you have not been granted access to it.
states.serverErrorTitle: The hub failed to handle the request
states.serverErrorDescription: Try again in a few minutes. If it keeps failing, send the request id below to an administrator.
states.networkErrorTitle: The hub API cannot be reached
states.networkErrorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
states.clientErrorTitle: The API did not accept the request
states.unexpectedDescription: Reload the page. If it keeps failing, send the reference below to an administrator.
